description: Source code for Electron-related classes in Playwright, including Electron and ElectronApplication, managing Electron app launching, window handling, event listening, and evaluation.

classes.name: Electron
classes.description: Manages launching Electron applications via Playwright, providing methods to launch and interact with Electron apps.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Represents an Electron application instance, managing windows, events, evaluation, and lifecycle.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an Electron application with specified options.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to get an Electron instance from a channel object.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specified event with optional predicate and timeout.

methods.name: browserWindow
methods.description: Gets a handle to the BrowserWindow of a specific page.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the context of the Electron app.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: firstWindow
methods.description: Returns the first window or waits for one if none are open.
